clue.text: Returning soldiers will go here the wrong way round

definitions.meaning: troops sent home on leave go back to the front line when it ends
reversed, with the rear end facing forward

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for reversed in orientation, and literally the frontline place troops return to.

clue.text: In dry home in secure environment

indicators.note: the dry and home pieces sit inside the secure environment, so 'in' signals a container

parts.note: a bag is a secure place to keep things
TT, teetotal, means not drinking alcohol, i.e. dry
being 'in' means being at home

explanation.surface: Somebody stays sober at home, safely tucked away.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the side that is batting is 'in'; that is the single-word definition at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket side currently at the crease is said to be in, the same state as batting.

clue.text: In the auditorium gets hold of a few words

indicators.note: an auditorium is where an audience listens, so the word is taken as heard rather than as written

parts.note: claws means grabs or gets hold of

explanation.surface: Someone in a theatre grabs a snatch of dialogue.
explanation.definitionFit: A clause is a short grammatical unit, a group of a few words with a verb.

clue.text: Ignore this stupid speculating

indicators.note: stupid suggests muddled, so the letters of the two words before it are jumbled

explanation.surface: Advice to disregard some foolish guesswork.
explanation.definitionFit: Forming theories without proof is a synonym for speculating.

clue.text: What shepherd has to close down

definitions.meaning: a shepherd keeps sheep in a pen or enclosure
a business that ceases trading is said to ...

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a sheep pen and, as a verb, a business going under.

clue.text: Fussy person losing heart would moan terribly

indicators.note: terribly suggests something badly done, so the letters are rearranged
the heart of a word is its central letter, which is dropped from would

explanation.surface: A fusspot, deprived of courage, would complain dreadfully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing heart' removes U, the middle of WOULD, leaving WOLD; 'terribly' then rearranges WOLD and MOAN.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal, somewhat dated idiom for a fussy, timid person of either sex.

clue.text: After journey I look up a city in Africa

indicators.note: the reversed piece follows the journey piece, so after orders the charade

parts.note: a trip is a journey

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the pieces are read from bottom to top, i.e. backwards

parts.note: lo is an old exclamation meaning look

explanation.surface: Back from a trip, someone looks up an African city on the map.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' reads the I-and-look pair from bottom to top; 'look' is the old exclamation 'lo!', as in 'lo and behold'.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripoli is the capital of Libya, on the North African coast.

clue.text: Stuff at sea — it floats around

indicators.note: something floating around drifts out of position, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something drifts about on the ocean, stuffed full.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At sea' itself sounds like an anagram signal, but here it is fodder; 'floats around' is the indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: To satiate is to fill to the full, a synonym of stuff as a verb.

clue.text: Knight going out with no care still

indicators.note: going out suggests things scattering out of order, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A knight leaves, still without a worry in the world.
explanation.definitionFit: Lancelot is a famous Knight of the Round Table in Arthurian legend.

clue.text: Boys and tot featuring in stories

indicators.note: the tot piece appears inside the stories piece, so featuring in signals a container

parts.note: lies are untrue stories
to tot up is to add

explanation.surface: Lads and a toddler appear in tales.
explanation.definitionFit: Laddies is an affectionate, chiefly Scottish word for boys.

clue.text: Demonic killer with wrongly directed longing, outwardly amiable — strange!

indicators.note: the amiable piece lies on the outside of the reversed longing

parts.note: sweet means amiable or kind

indicators.note: pointed the wrong way, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a yen is a longing
odd means strange

explanation.surface: A fiendish murderer, his desire misplaced, seems pleasant on the outside, oddly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outwardly' looks like it describes the amiable look, but it says the kind word wraps round the backwards longing; 'wrongly directed' is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweeney Todd is the fictional demon barber of Fleet Street who murdered his customers.

clue.text: Restriction certainly needed for cover again

parts.note: a rein is a restraint or restriction
sure means certainly

explanation.surface: Curbs are definitely required for repeat insurance.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinsure is to take out insurance cover once more.

clue.text: Return to base and make an impression

definitions.meaning: to head back to one's house
a remark that strikes home or hits its target takes effect

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both going back to one's house and a point landing with force.

clue.text: I utter real drivel — it gets published

indicators.note: drivel is nonsense, so the three words before it are turned into a jumble

explanation.surface: A writer confesses to talking rubbish that still makes it into print.
explanation.definitionFit: Literature is written work, the body of books that are put out in print.

clue.text: Seaweed carried by coastal gatherers

indicators.note: the answer is carried within the letters of the two words that follow

explanation.surface: Beachcombers pick up kelp along the shore.
explanation.definitionFit: An alga is a simple water plant; seaweeds are large marine examples.

clue.text: I am brought into English establishment for assessment

indicators.note: the I am piece is placed inside the establishment piece

parts.note: a station is an establishment, e.g. a research or military post
contracted to I'm

explanation.surface: Someone joins an English institution to be evaluated.
explanation.definitionFit: Estimation means judgement or valuation, a synonym for assessment.

clue.text: Crop bound to be found in county

parts.note: corn is a cereal crop
a bound is a boundary or limit, such as a wall

explanation.surface: A field of grain enclosed by a boundary in the shires.
explanation.walkthrough: CORNWALL is the county at the far south-western tip of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Cornwall is an English county, a named example of the category.

clue.text: Blasted trick discovered by someone on the paper

parts.note: a con is a swindle or trick
found means discovered
ED is short for editor, a newspaper's chief

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor uncovers a wretched swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: Confounded is a mild curse word, used like damned or blasted.

clue.text: Book 4 — or maybe 1,2,3!

definitions.meaning: the fourth book of the Old Testament
examples of figures used for counting

explanation.definitionFit: The fourth Bible book shares its name with the figures used in counting.

clue.text: Run into street? Careful!

indicators.note: the run piece goes into the street piece

parts.note: way is a road or street, as in Milky Way or Broadway
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A warning against dashing out into the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Being wary means being cautious, a synonym of careful.

clue.text: Understood to be fake

definitions.meaning: false, as in an alias or pretended name

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both presumed true and false, as in an alias someone takes on.

clue.text: Inferior collection displayed in company

indicators.note: the collection piece is shown inside the company piece

parts.note: a heap is a pile or collection

explanation.surface: A shoddy group of items exhibited in a firm.
explanation.definitionFit: A slang adjective for cheap and of poor quality, i.e. inferior.

clue.text: Word of prayer choking army officer in expression of grief

indicators.note: the prayer word is lodged inside the officer piece as if stuck in the throat

parts.note: LT is short for lieutenant
amen is said at the end of a prayer

explanation.surface: An officer chokes on a prayer word while mourning.
explanation.definitionFit: A lament is a song or cry of mourning, an outpouring of sorrow.

clue.text: Aggressive style of Scot — the male's male, nothing more!

parts.note: Mac is a nickname for a Scotsman
his means belonging to a male
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A Scotsman's swagger: masculinity and nothing else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'more' at the end is just a link to round off the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Machismo is an aggressively masculine attitude or manner.

clue.text: Conspiracy in bed?

definitions.meaning: a small piece of ground for growing plants

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a secret scheme and a garden patch for growing flowers.

clue.text: Sort of growth that could bring elation

indicators.note: rearranging the answer could bring about the word elation, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A kind of development that might cause joy.
explanation.walkthrough: This works backwards: the answer, rearranged, would bring 'elation'.
explanation.definitionFit: A toenail grows continuously, so it is a type of bodily growth.

clue.text: Not 'urt — or partially limbless?

definitions.meaning: the h-dropping Cockney form of unhurt, unharmed
without arms, having lost some limbs

explanation.definitionFit: The word is h-less unharmed and also, literally, lacking arms.

clue.text: What you may see in these conditions in a flash!

definitions.text: What you may see in these conditions
definitions.meaning: the letters of the word for second run across the gap between these and conditions, so it is split

explanation.definitionFit: A tiny instant of time, the briefest moment, as in a flash.
